title: The more ... the more: schools spread through the country

sections.content: You know *cuanto más ..., más ...* and *a medida que* from B1 Unit 2. Both link two changes that grow together: *a medida que* + a verb says that one thing happens gradually while another happens, and *cuanto más ..., más ...* says that the second grows with the first. They are useful for processes in history, such as the spread of schools.

items.spanish: A medida que se abrían escuelas rurales, se necesitaban más maestros.
items.english: As rural schools opened, more teachers were needed.

items.spanish: Cuanto más se extendía la escuela, más visible era el Estado.
items.english: The more the school spread, the more visible the State was.

items.spanish: Cuanto más crecía la red de escuelas, más maestros trabajaban en el campo.
items.english: The more the network of schools grew, the more teachers worked in the countryside.

items.spanish: A medida que crecía el número de escuelas, cambiaba la vida de muchos pueblos.
items.english: As the number of schools grew, the life of many villages changed.

sections.content: *Cuanto* does not change when a verb follows it. Use *menos* for the opposite direction (*cuanto menos aislado estaba un pueblo, más contacto tenía con el gobierno*). With *a medida que* the verb is in the indicative when you narrate the past.
